items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Treat equivalent wildcard forms as covered**

When an allowed entry and a blast-radius glob express the same language with wildcards in a different order, this token-by-token absorption reports the scope as outside. For example, `dir/*?` and `dir/?*` both match every nonempty single path segment under `regime-ci.py` semantics, but `covers("dir/*?", "dir/?*")` returns false; the script therefore writes an unnecessary pending decision and exits 3 even though the entire prospective scope is allowed. The containment check needs to account for equivalent wildcard languages rather than conservatively rejecting them.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->
